liquid_transfer.rationale: A liquid-transfer failure on 4 wells leaves wrong concentrations that remeasuring cannot fix, so I exclude those wells and queue their conditions for the next batch. This adds no time or device change, so no reschedule is needed.

plate_misplaced.rationale: A misplaced plate during the move to the incubator affects no wells, so a 2-minute re-placement retry is the cheapest fix. Rescheduling accounts for the small delay to downstream plates.

device_down.rationale: arm1 has no alternative device, so the only option is to wait out its 90-min repair (until t=415). Device availability changed, so the schedule must be recomputed to protect plate timing windows.

tip_pickup.rationale: A tip pickup failure transfers no liquid, so no wells are affected. Using the next tip costs 1 min and is assumed to work, avoiding the risk of a repeat failure that a retry carries.

measurement.rationale: A single re-read costs one read time and may clear the four outlier wells. Invalidating them as a fallback keeps wrong values away from the optimizer, and reschedule is set because the extra read shifts reader timing.
